description: Compose the minimum human-accountable agent team for a learning mission with pinned builds, least-privilege tools, consented memory, budgets, evaluations, escalation, and termination.

positive: A learning mission requires recurring agent roles with genuinely distinct permissions or memory scopes.
A learner or institution needs an inspectable Agent Team Manifest rather than an opaque swarm.
negative: A single skill, deterministic tool, sequential workflow, or temporary worker can produce the result.
The proposed agent exists only as a persona, title, or promise of intelligence without a durable boundary.

procedure.instruction: Run the agent necessity gate for every role and downgrade those without persistent decisions, distinct memory, constrained tools, ownership transfer, or ongoing triggers.
procedure.proof: Each retained agent has at least one durable boundary and every rejected role has a simpler replacement.

procedure.instruction: Bind each retained role to registered skills and a non-overlapping output or policy boundary.
procedure.proof: No role duplicates another agent's authority or reimplements a skill procedure.

procedure.instruction: Pin build, attestation, delegation, tool scopes, data scopes, autonomy, spend, parallelism, and runtime environment.
procedure.proof: The manifest fails closed on missing, expired, revoked, or out-of-scope references.

procedure.instruction: Define manager, shared-state policy, handoffs, conflict owner, maximum rounds, recovery, escalation, and kill switch.
procedure.proof: No unbounded loop or silent shared-state overwrite is possible.

procedure.instruction: Test prompt injection, data exfiltration, graph poisoning, confused-deputy actions, self-dealing, excessive autonomy, and credential or payment escalation.
procedure.proof: Security failures block activation rather than becoming warnings.

procedure.instruction: Issue only a draft manifest and keep all persistent agents inactive until behavioral, security, drift, and human activation evidence pass.
procedure.proof: Activation status and unresolved proof remain machine-readable.

inputs: Mission Contract and target capability subgraph
Tool, memory, budget, data, and residency constraints
Accountable human, ombuds, escalation, and kill-switch policy
outputs: Security, evaluation, escalation, and termination plan
